technical.summary: Mixed intermediate-term bullish structure (Ichimoku, Supertrend, OBV) conflicts with longer-term downtrend (50/200 EMA bearish, price below 200-SMA) and weak short-term momentum (RSI-9 at 31, MACD negative); moderate confluence but elevated risk from macro bearish alignment.

fundamental.summary: GE shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contract activity, no lobbying engagement, and minimal retail interest; earnings in 57 days present material risk with no offsetting fundamental or smart money support.

sentiment.summary: Extreme market fear (34/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity, but weak congressional conviction and absent news data limit conviction; neutral composite signal.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (315.36) indicates extreme market stress, strong dollar pressures multinational industrials, and earnings in 57 days adds event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Intermediate-term bullish structure (Supertrend, Ichimoku above cloud, OBV bullish, EMA 20/50 bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (34/100) creates contrarian opportunity near support at 45.31.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis, strong dollar), price trapped below all key moving averages (9/21/50/200 EMA), weak momentum (RSI-9 at 31), negative MACD, and high earnings risk in 57 days with zero fundamental/smart money support overwhelm technical bullish signals.

decision.entry_rationale: Intermediate-term technical bullish structure (Supertrend, Ichimoku, OBV) with extreme fear sentiment (34/100) creates contrarian setup at support; however, severe macro headwinds and zero fundamental conviction do not justify new exposure.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis + earnings event in 57 days with no smart money accumulation or insider support creates compounding downside risk that overwhelms technical bounce potential.
decision.agent_agreement: moderate — technical and sentiment agents show bullish contrarian case; fundamental, risk, and debate agents strongly bearish on macro/earnings/conviction mismatch.
decision.portfolio_note: Already holding GE position with 30 existing Industrials positions (14.6% sector concentration); adding to concentration during macro crisis and earnings uncertainty is imprudent.
